cases.command: mkdir -p /data2/anc && ls /data2/anc && echo hi > /data2/anc/d1/leaf.txt && ls /data2/anc && ls /data2/anc/d1
cases.note: On a flat keyed store one put materializes every missing level of the key, so the write has to refresh the listings above the immediate parent too. The first ls caches an empty /data2/anc; invalidating only the parent would keep serving it until the index TTL expires.
